reviews.body: Part of kiddos birthday gift and she liked it very much. Obviously she didn't run a professional puppet show with them but she had fun creating new characters. Haven't seen her play with them since but they haven't been donated yet so there's that. Thanks!

reviews.name: Ying Yang Dog
reviews.title: Crafts for Creative Children
reviews.body: What fun! I do crafts with my grandnephews and grandnieces. They loved making puppets. The only word of warning is have some glue ready because the pieces don’t always stick.

reviews.name: George
reviews.title: Vampire Freddy
reviews.body: such a simple and great plushie my first Jazwares plush and i love it the eyes glow in the dark more than i thought they would and looks amazing at night, is really soft, such a cool iteration from the original Freddy simple but still different

reviews.name: Hiilu
reviews.title: Bonnie :)
reviews.body: I really like the quality of the jazwares plushies, they have very consistent features (compared to fnaf plushies' historic bootleg-looking tendencies) and the fabric is SO SOFT! I can't stop petting him. The glowing eyes glow for a long time.

reviews.name: Henry Thaden
reviews.title: Great for FNAF collectors
reviews.body: Came on time and in great condition but I would like to add that the color seems to be a bit off in person. I don't know if that is just mine, my lighting, or just in general (camera makes it look more accurate) but other than that it is a great product and is SUPER soft!

reviews.name: Krystle
reviews.title: Cool little dinos
reviews.body: My son loved these. They are really cute. He clips them in his shirt. They were a big hit. Would make great party favors!

reviews.name: Jackie
reviews.title: Extremely durable!
reviews.body: Got these as a birthday gift for my three year old. They're a hit, he loves them! I honestly couldn't be more impressed! My son is EXTREMELY rough with his toys (as most boys are), and they're some of the only toys he HASNT broken! Great quality for a great price!

reviews.name: Krystal
reviews.title: Joyful
reviews.body: Some grab and hold better than others, but they're super cute and I'm impressed at their movable limbs. I have my favorite one sitting on my desk under my computer monitor. One of them gripped so tight it hurt, one didn't grip hard enough to stay, it most did. I'd buy them for anyone who likes dinos.
